description.text: The first set of the HeartGold & SoulSilver series, named after the games, released in February 2010 with 124 cards: 123 and a secret Alph Lithograph. It replaced the Platinum era's Pokémon LV.X and SP with Pokémon Prime, holo close-ups of a Pokémon's face with strong attacks and no special rules, six of them here, and with Pokémon LEGEND: Ho-Oh and Lugia, each one Pokémon printed across two cards played together, with the attack text turned sideways. The cards and the basic Energy took a new design.

description.text: A Cracked Ice holofoil copy from the Stage 1 Blisters sold quietly at Toys "R" Us and similar stores in November 2011. Each held one Stage 1 line, Ninetales, Xatu or Gliscor, with an Emerging Powers booster pack and an Emerging Powers sampling pack. This card and the Vulpix beside it were printed with the Undaunted expansion symbol instead of HeartGold & SoulSilver's, so every Cracked Ice copy carries the wrong symbol.
